title: Require a value
summary: GraphQL: Require a value. Return Asha instead and print result.data.
introduction: The exclamation mark means a field must not be null. This resolver breaks that rule, so GraphQL reports an error.
learningObjectives: Return Asha instead and print result.data

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install graphql@16. Save one example as lesson.mjs and run node lesson.mjs. These examples execute queries locally and do not need an HTTP server.

blocks.title: Require a value

blocks.text: The resolver returns null for a field marked non-null. GraphQL reports the schema-rule failure.

blocks.title: Expected result
blocks.content: Cannot return null for non-nullable field Query.name.

blocks.text: Return Asha instead and print result.data.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use non-null only when the resolver can honour that promise.
